META_TITLE: Analytics Dashboard — See Where Your Money Goes | FincWin
META_DESCRIPTION: FincWin's analytics dashboard shows net flow over time, category breakdowns, smart insights and net worth — so you see exactly where your money goes. Free to start.
OG_DESCRIPTION: Net flow, category breakdowns, smart insights and net worth — all in one private, offline dashboard. Free.
FEATURE_SUBHEAD: One dashboard for net flow, category spending, net worth and smart insights — updated as you go, no spreadsheets required.
PROBLEM_HEADLINE: Your numbers are scattered across apps and statements
PROBLEM_BODY:
Income in one app, spending in another, balances in a third. Piecing together the full picture takes hours you don't have — so most people never do.

FincWin pulls it together into one view: what came in, what went out, where it went, and where you stand.
HOW_IT_WORKS:
• Log your activity — add income and expenses, or import a CSV.
  • See net flow — a clear chart of money in vs out over time.
  • Drill into categories — find the spending that actually moves the needle.
  • Read your insights — FincWin surfaces trends and outliers automatically.
CAPABILITIES:
• ✓Monthly net flow chart over time.
  • ✓Category breakdowns to spot where money leaks.
  • ✓Smart insights highlighting trends and outliers.
  • ✓Net worth tracking across accounts and assets.
  • ✓Multi-currency totals.
  • ✓Offline & private — your data never leaves your device.
